Name: Tortierre
Author: julycanthrope
Description:
Edits Pierre's sprites and portraits to turn him into a tortilla.

The tortilla in the portraits is (a lower-pixel mangled version of) art by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37274]6480[/url]. (I saw the perms were open so I didn't directly ask, but if you want me to take this down, let me know.)

Tortierre is of course compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37299]Pierre REALLY Hates Tortillas[/url], which is extremely funny to me.
